profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
My journey over the last decade as an experienced software engineer has been marked by a commitment to delivering robust enterprise software solutions. My expertise in C# and .NET frameworks, coupled with a strong foundation in numerical analysis, enables me to tackle complex challenges in software development. Leading agile teams and spearheading software designs, the focus has been on driving efficiency and innovation in project management and execution.

At Microsoft, our endeavors and collaborative efforts have resulted in successfully meeting technical business requirements for all our customers. The mentoring and guidance provided to new hires reflect my dedication to fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within our teams. The seamless integration of mathematical acumen into software engineering practices has been a distinctive feature of my approach to problem solving in complex technology spaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Deliver “performance as a feature” by drastically improving speed & performance of document editing, collaboration, and video streaming end-user scenarios as part of the FLASH (files and performance) team within ODSP (OneDrive / SharePoint)
•	Collaborate with partner teams across Office 365 to leverage org-wide expertise in meeting UX performance goals
•	Activate curiosity across the SharePoint monolith to design, implement, & own platform-level features at cloud-scale to help make core end-user scenarios uber fast (<50ms stack letancy per API call)
•	Leverage wealth of telemetry & big data streams to make data-driven decisions every day, from feature ideation to collaborative partner sessions
•	Drove several platform-level features within SharePoint Online from ideation to implementation:
o	Combined key SQL sprocs in a request to 1 round-trip, saving up to 10% server latency on request APIs
o	Built a server-side memory cache to host popular file blobs, saving up to 15% server latecy on request APIs
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · C# · .NET Framework · Data Analysis · SQL · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Mentoring · Performance Analysis · C++

positions.title: Software Strategy Lead
positions.description:
• Consult in assisting software leadership team with organization of team priorities, training programs, and other internal initiatives
• Regularly identify improvements to existing software project management processes, most notably spearheading company adoption of a new software project management track (BGMS) to be adopted by all software projects going forward
• Provide ongoing support for high-priority clients during critical times, from sales quotations to customer support activities

positions.title: Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
Design, delegate, and deliver project components as software lead of large-scale sortation systems for warehouses & distribution centers.
• Led ad-hoc agile development teams as Scrum Master and Product Owner using Azure DevOps
• Passionately mentored and guided new hires to ensure team and company success
• Maintained and updated standard software stack components in C++/C# , Angular, Typescript, SQL, etc.
• Expanded sales portfolio with IoT products, namely BEUMER's first mobile application prototype and initial put-wall concept
• Developed statistical analyses and formulas resulting in a 7% loop sorter efficiency for a key customer

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: • Reviewed literature in Numerical Analysis and Total Least Squares under Dr. Jesse Barlow

positions.title: Software Automation Tester
positions.description:
• Tested UPS WorldShip application for medium- to large-sized shippers via automated script execution
• Created, executed, and maintained test scripts and automation tools for the automation team
• Updated test cases and VM environments resulting from ongoing application development

positions.title: Student Research
positions.description:
•	Worked on research project with colleague under the direction of mentor Dr. Ursula Wolz
•	Data-mined Facebook information of university students
•	Made inference to privacy-sensitive data and conducted on-campus surveys

positions.title: Student Research
positions.description:
•	Worked on individual research project under the direction of mentor Dr. Wooi Lim
•	Performed time series analysis various data (i.e. stock market values, gold prices, oil prices) with the aid of data mining techniques
•	Worked in the statistical programming language R for times series analysis, and used Python for data mining trend data

positions.title: Math Tutor & Grader
positions.description:
•	Tutored all undergraduate math courses in the Math department’s tutor room
•	Graded homework assignments for Calculus I classes

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Funded by GS-LSAMP grant & Hoffman-La Roche grant
•	Continued prior summer’s research with mentor Dr. Linda Kaufman
•	Applied research to sample problems and generated results
•	Applied advances in our research into a new project involving UNICEF data
•	Mentored high school student Adriano Pena through our research and applying it to the UNICEF data
•	Assisted Adriano Pena in preparing and presenting a talk on his summer with our research to our College of Science and Health and our sponsors from Hoffman-La Roche

positions.title: Grader
positions.description: •	Graded homework assignments and projects for a basic computer science class

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Funded by GS-LSAMP grant
•	Assisted mentor Dr. Linda Kaufman working on her paper titled “Solving Separable
Nonlinear Least Squares Problems with Multiple Data Sets”
•	Applied knowledge in linear algebra and advanced calculus to problem-solving
•	Worked in a UNIX environment in the programming language FORTRAN

positions.title: Junior Research Assistant
positions.locationName: New Use Agriculture, Rutgers, New Brunswick, NJ
positions.description:
•	Worked in a group with three other students in assisting mentor Dr. James E. Simon
•	Extracted solutions from plant samples (Mondia, Kudzu, Kinkeliba) from Africa and measured their phenolic antioxidant activity through chemical means using a spectrophotometer
